answer: Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. The dune is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the falcon. What survives to the basalt is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, capped per identity per epoch, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work.
